item.title: Fakhruddin Properties Collaborates with Holcim UAE to Boost Construction
item.description: Fakhruddin Properties, one of the UAE’s leading sustainability-oriented developers, and Holcim UAE, the leading partner for sustainable construction, have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to jointly advance sustainable construction across the region.
